claims.text: Start 5 mg PO BID with food
claims.quote: The recommended starting dose of Corlanor is 5 mg twice daily with food.

claims.text: (2.5 mg BID if conduction defects or bradycardia could compromise hemodynamics).
claims.quote: In patients with a history of conduction defects or other patients in whom bradycardia could lead to hemodynamic compromise, initiate therapy at 2.5 mg twice daily

claims.text: After two weeks, titrate to a resting HR of 50–60;
claims.quote: Assess patient after two weeks and adjust dose to achieve a resting heart rate between 50 and 60 beats per minute (bpm)
The maximum dose is 7.5 mg twice daily.
< 50 bpm or signs and symptoms of bradycardia

claims.text: ↓ by 2.5 mg BID, and stop if already at 2.5 mg BID.
claims.quote: Decrease dose by 2.5 mg (given twice daily); if current dose is 2.5 mg twice daily, discontinue therapy

claims.text: Avoid moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (diltiazem, verapamil, grapefruit juice)
claims.quote: Avoid concomitant use of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors when using Corlanor. Examples of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors include diltiazem, verapamil, and grapefruit juice

claims.text: and CYP3A4 inducers (St. John's wort, rifampin, barbiturates, phenytoin).
claims.quote: Avoid concomitant use of CYP3A4 inducers when using Corlanor. Examples of CYP3A4 inducers include St. John’s wort, rifampicin, barbiturates, and phenytoin

claims.text: Fetal toxicity: females of reproductive potential should use effective contraception.
claims.quote: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception when taking Corlanor
